questions.prompt: Which metrics from the roadmap should this chunk implement?
questions.description: Roadmap lists: papers analyzed, figures analyzed, processing time, returning users, papers per user, share events, comparison events, success rate.
questions.recommendedAnswer: All listed metrics. Aggregate from existing tables where possible, add processing_time_ms to documents, create analytics_events for comparison/share events.

questions.prompt: How to track 'returning users' without auth?
questions.description: PaperViz is no-auth for MVP. Returning users = unique user_id values (set on signup) + anonymous docs with NULL user_id.
questions.recommendedAnswer: Count unique user_ids from documents table. Anonymous docs (NULL user_id) counted separately. No IP tracking.

questions.description: Need to measure time from document creation to pipeline completion.
questions.recommendedAnswer: Add processing_time_ms column to documents table. Set on pipeline completion in intake.go.

questions.prompt: Should comparison and share events go in a new analytics_events table?
questions.description: Documents/charts already have share_visits/share_conversions counters. Comparison has no tracking at all.
questions.recommendedAnswer: Yes, create analytics_events table for comparison events. Share events already tracked via counters on documents/charts — reuse those.

questions.prompt: What API shape for the analytics endpoint?
questions.description: Need a dashboard endpoint to expose the metrics.
questions.recommendedAnswer: GET /api/analytics returns all metrics in one response. Auth required. Simple JSON object.

questions.prompt: Any metrics you want to defer to a later chunk?
questions.description: Some metrics (workflow depth, cost per operation) might be better deferred until more features exist.
questions.recommendedAnswer: Defer workflow depth and cost-per-operation. Focus on the core 8 metrics listed in the roadmap.
